criteria.title: Feasible roadmap, measurement, and handoff
criteria.description: The phased roadmap has usable owners, dependencies, resource estimates, reserved capacity, launch-aware timing, measurable KPI checkpoints, and risk responses that make the plan executable over 12 months.
